title: Workspace layout configuration schema
description: Validation schema for conf/workspace.conf.yaml: the structural blueprint of the workspace. A recursive tree of nodes; each node binds a path (with <slug> placeholders) to an optional artifact schema + template and a cardinality. Artifact-to-artifact derivation constraints (which kinds a given artifact may declare as sources) live in the artifact schemas themselves — the node's `schema` binding is the join point.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of this node. Folder or file; <slug> segments are placeholders.

cardinality.description: How many instances of this node may exist at this position.

schema.description: The artifact schema filename (in schemas/) that validates this node's file.

template.description: The artifact template path that seeds this node's file.
